name: BDD: Check company details
summary:
User Story:  GWA-20696, GWA-20909

Tier(/s): Office

Brand: UK

Account type(/s): Admin
preconditions:
Entry points: 

    1. Create a new unconfirmed account
    2. Open activation link 
    3. Go to the Company address page

    Notes:

    • Fill all fields with valid values, except current
    • To check all strings change the language to en_us if possible

steps.name: Observe the page
steps.expectedResult:
Text - Business Information Verification

Text - Company details


Field - Active legal representatives (Listed in the Company House Register)

Button - Add more representatives

Text - Ownership details

Radio buttons:

  • Sole trader
  • Partnership
  • Limited liability partnership
  • Limited company
  • Other (e.g. Association, Cooperative)

Field - Website (Provide telephone number if website is not available)

Checkbox - Company conducts Banking or Financial activities

Field - VAT number

Field - Data universal number (DUNS) 

Button - Save and continue(disabled)

steps.name:
Check fields validation:

  1. Check "Active legal representatives " field with more than 64 symbols
  2. Check "Ownership details" field  with option other more than 64 symbols
  3. Check "Website" field  with option other more than 64 symbols
  4. Check "Data universal number" field  with option other more than 64 symbols

Remove all added trading names.

Fill all fields with valid data and click button "Save and continue" is enabled
